# Bounded-generation MEP transcript

`session-model-access.md` is a byte-for-byte copy of
`spec/mep/smithy/transcripts/session-model-access.md` from finos/morphir at
`fe2213fc7d1136988e8aad684c1f2116510319c3`. Its SHA-256 is
`2b564178596e1c7420fc8c689b31e7dbd68dabaed3d57ac0e9497ce21886cb34`.

The worker test replays the initialization prefix through the shared
conversation. The later messages supply the fixed input for start, advance,
cancellation, and close tests. The separate draft.1 recording keeps its
existing source and validation gate.
